properties.name: Projection anchor of the committed overview raster
properties.description: The polygon that was in bounds.geojson when src/app/public/dzi/regierungsviertel/overview_source.png was rendered. overview_projection() derives the render centre and px/m scale from the bounds extent, so the tone sampler in build_isometric_prisms must keep using THIS polygon, not the live bounds. Buildings in the task-09 expansion fall outside this raster and are written without a tone, which the viewer draws in the plain ivory isoFaceShade ladder.
properties.source: bounds.geojson as of v0.40.0 (commit 8b0728b) — the MVP polygon the overview render was projected from
